lesson_title: Five Ways to Make Something New
hook_text: Powder plus water, and twenty minutes later it can hold a broken arm.
clip_script: Saturday in Khayelitsha. Ayanda's arm: plaster of Paris and water, mixed and set. Uncle Sipho's floor: cement, sand, stone and water, mixed and set. The collage: flour and water, just mixed. Gogo's bread: dough mixed and baked. The twins' jelly: mixed, then cooled. And the walls? Clay mixed, shaped, dried, then fired in a kiln until it is rock-hard. Five ways to turn ordinary materials into something new.
visual_style: Whiteboard yard and kitchen with five little scenes, each with a plus sign and an arrow to the new material.
mood: Busy and homely, like a family workday with a science surprise.
pacing: Five quick scenes, each ending with the name of its method.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find three new materials made at your home this week.
